rules: Do not resend when the same package already reached another valid address at the same organization.
Treat a Gmail permanent DSN as delivery failure for the listed failed recipient only.
Do not infer delivery failure for CC recipients unless they are listed in the DSN failed-recipient field or produce a separate bounce.
Prefer current official or institution-published alternate contacts.
